preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 4000.
The length of the binary string S must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The binary string S must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of occurrences of the substring '01' in the modified string S.
